# `company.shipment_freight_billings`

Immutable: an invoice line that billed a shipment's freight, live while that invoice is posted and its current revision carries the line.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this billing. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + line_id | — | transactions.id | Invoice that billed the freight. |
| `line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + line_id | — | document_line_identities.id | Stable identity of the invoice line that billed it. |
| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_freight_billings_shipment | shipments.id | Shipment whose freight it billed. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this freight billing was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this freight billing. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this freight billing. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this freight billing. |
